page.notes: Printed text at the left margin: "Ratio assentiendi Generica" and "& Specifica." stand beside the paragraph at the corresponding places; they are printed as two separate margin notes and were placed beside "sicut ergo" and "specificam" respectively. The right edge strip shows the neighbouring page and is left out. Show-through from the other side makes "intellectus" in "per quam assentitur intellectus" and "sicut per hanc" partly unclear; the first is marked [?]. The catchword "distin-" stands alone at the right below the last full line. The reference "Rubius tract.1.de habit." is printed in roman after the text.
